column1: # Accepted deviations for tools/verify_arxiv.py: differences between a bibliography entry and the
# arXiv or Crossref record that are known, checked, and correct in the entry.
# One per line, tab-separated: key, field, value, reason.
#   field  the start of the tool's message: "author 5", "author count", "journal", "volume", "pages"
#   value  the value the record gives, as it appears in the message
#   reason why the entry is right and the record is not used
# A mismatch is accepted only if its key, field and value all match a line. Checked 2026-11-13.

column4: The entry follows the published NeurIPS version, whose Crossref record (DOI 10.52202/075280-3464) agrees with it; the arXiv preprint lists Cappelli fifth and Alobeidli sixth.
The arXiv metadata drops "Ben" from the surname Ben Allal; the entry gives the full surname.
The arXiv metadata of the latest version lists Aman Rangapur twice (second and seventh); the entry gives the nine distinct authors in that order.
The arXiv metadata misspells the surname Deng as "Dengr".
The entry follows the author order on the paper's first page (arXiv v3: Gijsbers fifth, Giner-Miguelez sixth); the arXiv metadata swaps them.

column3: Proceedings of the thiry-fourth annual ACM symposium on Theory of computing
column4: Crossref misspells "thirty-fourth" as "thiry-fourth" in the proceedings title (STOC 2002 was the 34th symposium).
RFC 8878 names two authors, Y. Collet and M. Kucherawy (editor); Crossref lists only one.
